title: My Potential
summary: An exploratory project on professional self-knowledge: recording skills, tracking how they evolve and spotting where a career's technical and creative potential lies.
problem: Technical careers get assessed through CVs and interviews, two formats that poorly capture how a person evolves: what they learn, what draws them and where they're growing.
audience: A conceptual project, aimed at professionals who want to understand their own trajectory.
responsibilities: Defining what measuring potential means without falling into empty metrics.
Modeling skills, evidence and evolution over time.
decisions: Evidence over self-declaration: what you've built weighs more than what you claim.
Evolution matters more than the snapshot.
outcomes: A clear conceptual framework and visualization prototypes.
Ideas that feed how I present my own work, this site included.
